# Draft:Kande Ela Reservoir, Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka

Kande Ela Reservoir—sometimes referred to as Meepilimana Reservoir—is a calm and scenic water body situated about 10 kilometres from Nuwara Eliya, along the route leading to Horton Plains. Constructed during the late 1940s and brought into use in 1950, it primarily functions as a source of drinking water for the surrounding region. The reservoir is also located close to the Kande Ela Educational Forest Park.
